title: LLM-wiki-kit fleet base frontmatter schema (single source of truth)
description: SOT for wiki-page YAML frontmatter across the fleet. Universal fields live here; per-vault variance (entity field, role enum, status additions, extra fields, topics prefix) lives in schema/vaults/<slug>.json overlays. The effective per-vault schema is base + overlay, assembled by build_effective_schema.py. Enforced by vault-lint check_9_frontmatter_schema and honoured by check-conformance (the CLAUDE.md frontmatter block is masked, since this file — not the prose — is authoritative). Validation-as-a-schema pattern adapted from JulianCataldo/remark-lint-frontmatter-schema (ISC) and the hierarchical-namespace model of dendronhq/dendron schema.yml (Apache-2.0); see CREDITS.md. No code copied.

$conformance.comment: Extension keys consumed by the vault-lint hand-rolled checker (stdlib-only; deliberately no jsonschema runtime dependency — mirrors lint.py's regex frontmatter parser). Standard JSON Schema keys above stay valid so this file can be handed to a real JSON Schema validator later without change.
$conformance.roles_owned_by: phase_2_role_drift — roles presence and membership are reported there; check_9 does not duplicate that.
